title: Safety and Efficacy of Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) Guided Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) in the Treatment of Pancreatic Lesions
official: Safety and Efficacy of Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) Guided Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) in the Treatment of Pancreatic Lesions: A Pancardinal-4 Prospective Registry
summary: This is a 7-year prospective single-center registry study to assess the safety and efficacy of Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) Guided Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) in the treatment of pancreatic lesions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of any pancreatic pre-malignant lesion and/or pancreatic malignancy
* Patients already undergoing EUS-RFA for treatment of pancreatic lesions clinically

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with co-existing malignancies of other organs (or a prior history of such)
* Patients unable to provide informed consent
* Patients unable to complete follow-up
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
